main.description: Whether the viewer's PDS serves permissioned spaces (proposal 0016). Answered from a cached probe of community.lexicon.service.describe.

supported.description: True when the PDS serves every space method grain needs.

pds.description: The PDS endpoint that was probed.

missing.description: Space methods grain needs that this PDS does not serve. Empty when supported; the full list when the PDS answers no describe at all.
